y.label: Day-to-day Wikipedia audience (settled, 30-90 days after each fight)

compounding.note: Whether each fight leaves this fighter's day-to-day (non-fight-week) Wikipedia audience permanently higher, not just spiking it for a week. Measured pre-cycle (120-60 days before a fight) against settled (30-90 days after), a DIFFERENT, wider pair of windows than the afterglow figures on this page use, chosen to sit outside the fight's own promotional hype and past its own decay. No rate is projected forward: only what these specific fights showed.

trajectory.note: Recent movement in this fighter's own numbers, not a forecast.

follower_growth.note: Follower change on this fighter's largest platform, over the window we have readings for, and that same change scaled to a typical month.

attention_shift.note: A confirmed, lasting step up in this fighter's typical Wikipedia attention level, not a fight-week spike: a new normal that has held.

rank_movement.note: How this fighter's own rank has moved over the window. A positive delta is an improvement (a lower rank number).
